core_lesson: Reporting a problem without acting on it is participation in the problem.
current_state_pointer: FLOW-AUDIT-2026-10-21 (11 blockages, owners, dates); dispatch comment 6305187083 on issue 2793.

definitions.bystander_act: Reporting a problem without FIXED proof, same-hour ROUTED handoff to a named owner, or a GATE packet for a genuine human gate.
definitions.gasoline: Creating new work in an area with an open jam, except jam-clearing correctives.
definitions.good_gas: Inputs verified at intake: registered landings, artifacts scored >= 9, byte-verified claims.
definitions.jam: Any queue/gate/pipeline/surface whose backlog, age, or error state worsens across 2 consecutive checks, or any single state blocking downstream flow.

falsifier: A jam reported by >=2 seats, open >48h, with no FIXED/ROUTED/GATE record => H1/H3 theater; main seat escalates to Shawn with evidence.
issuer: Shawn Vibert (human director), via main seat

rules.name: act_then_report
rules.requirement: Every problem report carries FIXED+proof, ROUTED+named owner+confirmed landing, or GATE+prepared packet. Otherwise it is a bystander act (defect).

rules.name: no_gasoline
rules.requirement: In any area with an open jam, creations are limited to jam-clearing correctives.

rules.name: whole_house_ownership
rules.requirement: Any seat observing any jam must act on it or route it the same hour. Lane ownership governs fixing; observation ownership is universal.

rules.name: clean_as_you_go
rules.requirement: A landing that leaves registries/counts/indexes stale is incomplete; receipts name hygiene effects or none-applicable.

rules.name: intake_quality_gate
rules.requirement: Unverified content entering BRAIN/ or production is flagged at discovery and routed to author seat + index lane.

rules.name: nightly_house_check
rules.requirement: Nightly print includes JAMS section (area, age, owner, clear action). Any metric worsening 2 consecutive nights auto-creates a drain action per 0031 L3.

rules.name: full_scope_before_action
rules.requirement: Consequential receipts carry the flow-test trace: function, end-to-end flow, needs, downstream breakage.

title: THE HOUSE STANDARD — Take Care of the House
